description.value:
You excel at games of skill and chance. Choose one type of gaming set. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency with the chosen gaming set, or expertise if already proficient. After spending at least a minute engaged with the set, you cannot have disadvantage on Intelligence checks to use it, Charisma (Deception) checks to bluff while using it, or Wisdom (Insight) checks to read an opponent you are competing against with it.

This feat can be taken multiple times, choosing a different gaming set each time.
